name: Dearmid
text: Dearmid is a variant spelling of the name Diarmait. The dictionary routes this spelling straight to that main entry. The heroic Diarmait Ua Duibne of the Fianna carries his full record under his own entry. So do the kings who share the name. Readers should follow the Diarmait entry for the name's full dossier.
